title: Atlas install pipeline sync - sprint 11 prep
content:
Context:
Quick prep notes for the weekly Atlas Systems sync (private deployment: hybrid VPC + on-prem). Focused on installation pipeline, infra readiness, and cutover windows. This is a working scratchpad for the 1:1s with Samira and Diego before the broader customer sync on Friday.

Goals for this week:
- Verify install automation passes in the staging rack (no manual steps remaining).
- Finalize network peering and customer firewall allowlist before scheduled data migration.
- Confirm HSM/KMS test vectors and cert rotation process with Atlas security.
- Triage remaining blockers that could push the canary date.

Agenda (for internal rehearsal / 20–30 min)
1) Quick status snapshot (5 min) — Samira
   - Staging registry state, installer run success rate, telemetry.
2) Open blockers (10 min) — Diego
   - Network/firewall, license key, on-prem operator access.
3) Cutover plan hedge (5 min) — Jordan
   - Canary window, rollback gates, data-migration pause/resume.
4) Action assignment & follow-ups (5 min) — Eliot

Milestones and status (short):
- M1: Staging installer automation green (expected): READY (staging runs 9/10 with minor post-install hook failures). Owner: Samira.
- M2: VPC peering + route propagation: IN PROGRESS (customer BGP/session flaps observed). Owner: Diego.
- M3: Secrets and KMS integration validated: BLOCKED (Atlas HSM test tokens pending). Owner: Security (contact: Priya Shah).
- M4: DB migration dry-run (snapshot->replica): PENDING (waiting on peering + access). Owner: DB eng (contact: Marcus Li).
- M5: Canary rollout window scheduled: TARGET 2025-11-18 (contingent on M2 and M3). Owner: Jordan.

Blockers (detailed):
- Firewall/IP allowlist: Atlas infra team has an internal change freeze this week; need an exception to add our egress IPs. Impact: prevents S3-backed bootstrap of images. Mitigation: request temporary NAT via customer gateway. Owner: Diego. ETA update: escalation in progress (asked for approval 2025-11-04).

- HSM/KMS test tokens delayed: Atlas security awaiting approval from procurement to sign CSP addendum. Without tokens we can't validate hardware-backed secrets rotation. Impact: cannot complete full security acceptance tests. Owner: Priya Shah (Atlas) / Samira (RWI). Remediation: prepare a software-KMS fallback test so we can run a partial acceptance in parallel.

- Installer post-hook flaky on edge nodes: intermittent systemd race causing agent registration failures (10% of runs). Impact: increases manual remediation time in staging. Owner: Eliot. Action: add a 10s jitter and a registration retry loop; add stronger logging around unit startup. Planned PR: GH:infra/atlas-installer#89.

Action items (owner, due):
- Diego: Push peering escalation to Atlas networking lead + provide packet captures; due 2025-11-06.
- Samira: Run a full installer smoke suite against staging rack with software-KMS fallback and share logs; due 2025-11-06.
- Eliot: Open PR for installer retry/jitter and extend unit test coverage for registration; due 2025-11-07.
- Jordan: Draft canary rollback checklist and communicate expected SLA impact to customer success; due 2025-11-08.
- Marcus Li (DB): Prepare a trimmed dry-run plan requiring only metadata access (workaround) and list precise privileges needed; due 2025-11-07.
- Security/Compliance: Provide signed attestation template we can use for Atlas procurement to accelerate HSM approval; due 2025-11-09.

Risks and open questions:
- If the Atlas procurement timeline slips >7 days, HSM gating will move the canary >2 weeks. Decide whether to run a limited canary without hardware-backed KMS (tradeoff: compliance acceptance risk).
- Customer change freeze windows are tight; confirm fallback maintenance windows (post-cutover) so we can plan immediate remediation if canary shows regressions.
- On-prem rack power sequencing: we need confirmation of UPS runtime (>30 mins) during initial bootstrap. 

Notes from last customer call (2025-11-01):
- Atlas requested an annotated runbook explaining exact escalation steps and Slack contacts for night ops. They prefer 24h turnaround for critical fixes during canary.
- Procurement committed to an update by 2025-11-05 but asked for a formal attestation doc. Action: Jordan to send template.

Decisions needed before Friday sync:
- Agree internal fallback: run canary with software-KMS if HSM not available, but only for non-regulated datasets. (Ops + Security sign-off required).
- Finalize cutover start window: propose 2025-11-18 03:00–07:00 UTC.

Prep checklist for Friday customer sync:
- One-pager of current blocker list and owners (send before meeting) — Jordan.
- Short demo of successful staging install (3–4 screenshots + logs) — Samira.
- Network capture summary and next steps — Diego.
- Draft contingency flowchart (canary fail => immediate rollback steps) — Eliot.

Next internal touchpoints:
- Quick 1:1 with Samira (status on smoke suite) — Tue 2025-11-05 09:30 PT.
- Short net triage with Diego & Atlas net lead — Wed 2025-11-06 11:00 PT.
- Dry run rehearsal (ops) if peering validated — Thu 2025-11-07 02:00 PT.

Meeting cadence: keep weekly Friday customer sync until canary completes; internal mini-standups M/W/F for this sprint.

Scratchpad ideas / optional improvements:
- Add a small telemetry check in the installer that emits a single signed heartbeat to Atlas telemetry collector to speed verification.
- Bake a "minimal compliance" install profile that omits HSM steps for early functional canaries, and clearly annotate the compliance tradeoffs.

Appendix - quick contact list:
- Atlas primary infra: Nora Ibrahim <nora@atlas.example.com>
- Atlas security: Priya Shah <priya@atlas.example.com>
- RWI owners: Jordan Lee (owner), Samira Khan (installer), Diego Alvarez (network), Eliot Park (ops), Marcus Li (DB)

Open items to capture in Confluence after sync:
- Final installer acceptance criteria (pass rate, mean time to repair).
- Canary decision matrix and sign-off checklist.

End of notes.
